units.displayText: In response to her attack, Magnhilda merely tilts her head aside to avoid it. Jiangyu then switches things up and strikes at her lower body.

units.displayText: However, Magnhilda's attacks are vicious and sharp, completely unlike Nascita's style.

units.displayText: Magnhilda doesn't duck. Instead, she grabs Jiangyu's hand and uses Jiangyu's momentum to throw her.

units.displayText: You can't win if all you do is run away.

units.displayText: Jiangyu freezes up as she hears those words, and then she immediately ducks a punch. Magnhilda's fist grazes her shoulder, and pain immediately floods from it into her processor hub.

units.displayText: She's right, but how should I attack... My systems are about to overheat, I can't even think about how I'm going to fight...

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

units.displayText: Magnhilda grimaces in pain. Seeing this, Jiangyu pulls back.

spans.text: Magnhilda grimaces in pain. Seeing this, Jiangyu pulls back.

units.rawText: Heh... I didn't think you'd rush at me so recklessly. Alright then, you win.

spans.text: Heh... I didn't think you'd rush at me so recklessly. Alright then, you win.

units.rawText: No, you could have avoided it... I could tell. I wouldn't have been able to hit you if you were actually trying to hurt me.
units.displayText: No, you could have avoided it... I could tell. I wouldn't have been able to hit you if you were actually trying to hurt me.

units.displayText: And I even hurt you too. Sorry about that.

spans.text: And I even hurt you too. Sorry about that.

units.displayText: Jiangyu, Coach Magnhilda, are you alright?

units.displayText: Nascita chooses this moment to step in and check their wounds.

units.rawText: Whew, fortunately they're just flesh wounds. A simple repair should be enough for them...

spans.text: Huh? Where did you come from, Nascita? You startled me.

units.rawText: YOU'RE the one who startled ME!
units.displayText: YOU'RE the one who startled ME!

spans.text: YOU'RE the one who startled ME!

units.rawText: We arranged to come here to practice, but when I arrived I saw you going all-out with someone else, and she's our martial arts coach to boot!
units.displayText: We arranged to come here to practice, but when I arrived I saw you going all-out with someone else, and she's our martial arts coach to boot!

spans.text: We arranged to come here to practice, but when I arrived I saw you going all-out with someone else, and she's our martial arts coach to boot!

spans.text: Eh? She's the martial arts coach?

units.displayText: Jiangyu stares in stunned silence at the dark-haired, dark-skinned woman before her, and then the reality of what she's just done catches up with her.

spans.text: Jiangyu stares in stunned silence at the dark-haired, dark-skinned woman before her, and then the reality of what she's just done catches up with her.

units.displayText: I... I'm terribly sorry!

spans.text: I... I'm terribly sorry!

units.rawText: I interrupted your practice and got you hurt. I don't know how I can make up for this...
units.displayText: I interrupted your practice and got you hurt. I don't know how I can make up for this...

spans.text: I interrupted your practice and got you hurt. I don't know how I can make up for this...

units.displayText: Don't worry, we were just having a simple spar.

spans.text: Don't worry, we were just having a simple spar.

units.rawText: Haha, so this is that Jiangyu you were talking about, Nascita. She really is an interesting one.
units.displayText: Haha, so this is that Jiangyu you were talking about, Nascita. She really is an interesting one.

spans.text: Haha, so this is that Jiangyu you were talking about, Nascita. She really is an interesting one.

units.rawText: Then... You're willing to coach her?
units.displayText: Then... You're willing to coach her?

spans.text: Then... You're willing to coach her?

spans.text: Yup. The way she threw herself at me without caring about herself really takes me back.

units.rawText: Ah... may I ask what you're talking about?
units.displayText: Ah... may I ask what you're talking about?

spans.text: Ah... may I ask what you're talking about?

units.rawText: Oh, Nascita asked me if I had time to coach an up-and-coming actress. I certainly didn't expect to run into you like this.
units.displayText: Oh, Nascita asked me if I had time to coach an up-and-coming actress. I certainly didn't expect to run into you like this.

units.displayText: Haha, congrats, Jiangyu. Magnhilda's a famous boxer, and she's willing to coach you for your action scenes!

units.displayText: Jiangyu quickly turns to bow deeply to Magnhilda.

units.rawText: No need to be so formal. The casting director is an old friend of my previous owner, which was why I agreed to help.
